reviews.text: Competent staff and a vet who was very attentive to my dog.

A superb team – kind, gentle, and very understanding.

Their prices are quite reasonable, and they don't charge for unnecessary services.

We've decided they will be our regular vet.
My little Pakkun Cavalier King Charles puppy had an ear infection; he was treated quickly, great team and great vet, I highly recommend them, a big thank you again!
Top-notch clinic, very friendly welcome, and my emergency was taken care of immediately. Thank you for this relief! 😮‍💨 A huge thank you to the team! 🤩 …
Top-notch veterinary services, from the reception staff to the assistants and doctors.

Absolutely fantastic! The team was incredibly helpful during my emergency. Everyone was so friendly, from the reception staff to the caregivers.
Thank you so much 🙏

Although I had notified them of my arrival to place the body of my deceased young dog in the cold room pending the autopsy at the nearby departmental lab, I arrived 6 minutes after their official closing time. The vet had left, and the employees still in the parking lot couldn't let me in... Luckily, I found another vet still open (the Martigues vet) because they were treating a kitten, and they agreed to take her in, free of charge!
Dr. Lorenzi takes the time to explain things to us, he takes the time with my very fearful dog, he's truly a vet like you don't see anymore! Thank you, doctor!

Competent and attentive staff in a clean, welcoming environment with parking.
Highly recommended.
A great team and thank you to Dr. Joubert for his professionalism and attentiveness.

An exceptional clinic that I highly recommend.
My deepest gratitude goes to Doctors Lorenzi and Champanet, who so effectively cared for our cat Potiron for 15 years. He now rests in Cat Heaven after a necessary euthanasia. We shared 15 years of tenderness and mutual love with him. Thank you, Doctors, for your professionalism and empathy. Now all that remains is to heal our hearts, broken by the loss of our little companion.

This was my first time at this vet's office. I didn't have an appointment; I went in as an emergency for my dog's eye. The reception was excellent, and I was seen quite quickly. The consultation was professional, and I found the prices reasonable. Thank you again.

Magnificent and exceptional, a place where everyone is kind and welcoming. Special mention to Dr. Lorenzi, a patient, attentive veterinarian who offers excellent advice. His professionalism is the likes of which I have never seen. Thank you, Doctor, for your kindness and dedication, and thank you to the ladies at reception who are so kind and welcoming. See you very soon!
Thank you to the whole team and a special thanks to Dr. Champanet for his kindness and empathy – the best!
Alright
Good, very professional team
I found an injured magpie and brought it to this clinic, and they took it in immediately and very kindly. Thank you to them; even though the poor magpie ended up dying, they still tried to save it.
Great team. Always very well received and advised.

I hate them. They have absolutely no humanity. It's a money-making machine. I was forced to have my beloved little furball euthanized almost two years ago. At their clinic. It was a painful experience. She was hospitalized there for tests, the outcome of which I already knew. She was nearing the end of her life, but to charge extra for services, they kept her overnight. I came back the next day only to hear what I already knew. One of the receptionists rushed towards me with a catalog to make me choose an urn... The "veterinarian" who brought her in so I could say goodbye before the lethal injection was holding her carelessly. It hurt so much... Even now, when I think about it, I still get tears in my eyes. She didn't have a single word, not a single gesture of compassion for us. Inhumane and disgusting behavior. If I were to adopt again, I would NEVER set foot in their place again.
The vet was available and very professional. Thank you.
This place is excellent and welcoming. Dr. Lorenzi is top-notch, a fantastic doctor who takes great care of your animals and is incredibly conscientious! 👍👍👍👍👍 …
I highly recommend him because he is professional and understanding.

Thank you for the diagnosis given to our cat Mitsuko: "He doesn't have an abscess, just a slightly enlarged liver that needs monitoring." As a bonus, two well-sold flea and tick pills to inflate the bill. For a cat who hadn't eaten for 5 days!
149 euros (I understand the cost of the blood tests, but the rest was just petting). You can take him back!... But the cat is still in the same condition.
Today, after a battery of tests concerning this liver problem, we changed veterinary clinics in Martigues.
We had to end our cat's life.
Two days wasted, which only worsened the situation.
Everyone can draw their own conclusions.
A very professional team 👍🏽 from the reception to the care provided by the veterinarians ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ thank you, our little darlings thank you 🙏 …
The team is always very friendly; they've been looking after my dog ​​since he was born.
I highly recommend this clinic; the staff and doctors are caring and always offer good advice.

A truly excellent team. Unfortunately, my dog ​​Diane was very ill with a very aggressive cancer. The entire team was very empathetic and took the time to support us, and the doctors explained everything to me with great kindness during our difficult separation. Thank you.

I wholeheartedly recommend this veterinary clinic. Thanks to you, my two cats had a peaceful life and passed away without suffering. You have a genuine love for animals, and they feel it. Thank you for everything.
I came in just for some information about a cat I need to bring back from abroad. The person at reception was very friendly and took the time to explain everything to me. Thank you!
A clinic with a human touch and very attentive to its patients

Loyal to this clinic for almost 25 years, no regrets. The younger generation has taken over from the older staff, maintaining the same friendly yet professional atmosphere. A competent and caring team. 👏 …

A fantastic veterinary clinic with excellent assistants and perfect vets.
My Rex is well cared for there, and they always have an emergency appointment available if needed.
A top-notch veterinary clinic. The staff are very friendly and attentive. They are very responsive.
The veterinarian and her colleagues are friendly, pleasant, and love animals.

Veterinarians who care about the animal's well-being. The assistants are also excellent. As a client for 20 years with various dogs, I've always received great support through thick and thin. I wouldn't change clinics for the world.

A clinic I highly recommend; the veterinarians are truly dedicated.

The assistants are fantastic and take the time to listen.

A special message for Dr. Lorenzi, who was my dog's vet until she passed away on December 2nd. Despite the pain that is still present, I wanted to thank you for your support. Mya trusted you, as did my other animals whom you care for, and that speaks volumes.

You are an exceptional veterinarian. Thank you.
Incompetent with cats, who doesn't hesitate to charge exorbitant prices for stray cats.
Very kind and empathetic people. 200% recommended!
A top-notch team

A very professional and caring clinic, both towards animals and owners, especially when you bring your four-legged companion in for euthanasia 🥺 because it's an incredibly painful experience 🙏. They also provide excellent diagnostic and medical follow-up.

I recommend them 200%.

The vet was kind and gentle with cats, but not competent. My cat had a lump between his shoulder blades that appeared and grew larger in less than a month, so we went to the vet only to be told it was just a fatty lump on my slim cat. Three months later, the lump had grown even larger, and that's when I finally learned it was a tumor. It could have been caught much earlier, and my cat could have lived longer if further tests had been done at the first visit, as initially requested.
Super vets

My three cats have been patients at this clinic since I moved to Marseille. The vets and assistants are fantastic. The wait for a routine appointment (like a booster shot) can sometimes be a bit long, but it's worth it because the vets are …
Top-notch
